svg.title: Updated MCP agentic data pipeline architecture
svg.desc: CSV file loads into MongoDB Atlas via load_mongodb.py, exports through exasol-json-tables into Exasol SaaS. Four Claude Code agents store recipes in Exasol tables and create analytics views, published via cloudflared tunnel.
svg.text: Run full pipeline · validates Exasol state after each agent · retries on failure
Exasol SaaS — single source of truth
All agents connect via Exasol MCP only
RECIPES.SCIENTIST → RECIPES.CHEF → ANALYTICS views → server.py → ECharts → public URL
